scope: one-shot supervised candidate development on the committed PsySUICIDE optimization partition; official valid is used for selection; frozen train holdout remains inaccessible until the gate passes

partition.holdout_access_before_gate: forbidden; only the already-published aggregate count and commitment may be checked

training.sampler: weighted replacement using inverse fourth-root class frequency
training.loss: class-weighted focal loss using inverse fourth-root class frequency and gamma=1.5
training.checkpoint_selection: highest official-valid macro-F1; exact ties choose the lowest seed
training.public_outputs: aggregate metrics, configuration, commitments, and hashes only; no text, ids, row-level predictions, weights, or trainer state

advancement_rule.primary: mean official-valid macro-F1 across seeds 42, 43, and 44 must be strictly greater than 0.5314999909201558
advancement_rule.regression_guard: the three-seed mean per-class F1 must not be more than 0.10 below the reference for any class with official-valid support at least 10
advancement_rule.decision_if_either_condition_fails: REJECT_SUPERVISED_V1; do not access or score the frozen holdout
advancement_rule.decision_if_both_conditions_pass: commit the selected seed, checkpoint SHA-256, aggregate valid metrics, and holdout scoring script before loading holdout membership; then score the selected checkpoint exactly once

inference_policy.holdout_result_status: one-time internal confirmation only, not the PsySUICIDE paper test split and not a substitute for external replication
inference_policy.statistical_claims: descriptive unless a paired test and its parameters were frozen before row-level holdout predictions are produced
